prompts.image2d: Use case: style-transfer. 为星契角色芭拉补齐二维手绘原画三视图，横向3:2。附图1是唯一权威角色身份、服装、比例与三视角布局参考，将其转绘为精致二维手绘角色设定原画：干净细腻的铅笔墨线、柔和水彩与不透明色彩薄涂，浅米白干净背景，非3D渲染。保留正面、朝左侧面、背面三位等高完整全身，耳尖与鞋底完整。严格保留青年女性白兔、修长清秀身形、柔和正脸、小口鼻、棕眼、粉内耳、白色及腰长卷发、半编发和后脑粉丝带；米白泡袖衬衫、柔粉色背带中长裙、裙边彩色小花草刺绣、浅米白平底鞋、单个短圆白尾。三视角衣装结构一致，正面旁保留一只藤编鲜花篮。自然垂手，手爪完整，保持参考面容和成熟度，不变成幼童或人类，不增配饰。无标题无文字无水印。这是原画版本，明确采用二维手绘，不能保留CG质感。
prompts.image3d: Make a precise LOCAL EDIT to the attached 3-view CGI character sheet. Change ONLY the facial features on the LEFT FRONT-FACING figure, within the face below the hairline. Preserve the ENTIRE middle side-profile figure and right back figure unchanged; preserve front figure body, height, head silhouette, ears, hair braid, clothing, hands, pose, shoes, basket, background and lighting. User explicitly APPROVED body, side face and back. The front face should be prettier, delicate, softer, more femininely humanoid in facial feature arrangement while retaining white fine fur and long rabbit ears. Reduce animal muzzle: flatten the protruding paired round whisker pads into smooth gentle narrow cheeks, remove pronounced Y-shaped split upper lip and projecting animal mouth. Make nose a tiny delicate softly pink nose with a subtle bridge, not a large rabbit triangle. Give a small naturally shaped closed mouth with subtle pale rose lips, elegant gentle smile, no teeth. Remove long prominent whiskers or reduce to barely visible fine short strands. Keep warm brown almond-shaped eyes near current size, refined eyelids, gentle brows, balanced attractive face, graceful jaw and chin. Not a human skin face pasted on: preserve fine white facial fur, consistent CGI shading and natural transition to furry neck. Avoid exaggerated Disney animal expression, puffy muzzle, large nose, oversized eyes. Keep SAME sheet dimensions/layout, precise film CGI fur and fabric, no other alterations, no text.

assetPrompts.portraits/02-白兔姐姐采花-探索v2.png: Edit the referenced white rabbit older sister into a fresh youthful flower-picking character proposal for AstralPact. ONE full-body portrait cinematic image, complete long ears and both feet in frame. Preserve WHITE fur, rabbit face and muzzle, pink nose, warm expressive brown eyes, elegant anthropomorphic rabbit anatomy and high-end feature-film 3D CGI quality. Make her feel more girlish, lively, innocent and light, a young maiden rather than a mature office worker. Change hairstyle from mature bun to soft white loose hair with a simple half-up braid and small pale green ribbon. Replace entire old blue cardigan/blouse/long dark skirt/bag costume with a fresh spring outfit: ivory short puff-sleeve blouse beneath a delicate light sage-green pinafore dress, softly gathered skirt ending below knees, subtle tiny daisy embroidery along hem, comfortable cream flat shoes. Simple ordinary-family clothes, no ornate jewelry. She is picking wildflowers in a sunlit spring meadow: gently lean and reach with one furred hand to pick a small daisy growing beside her while carrying a small woven wicker basket containing a modest handful of white daisies and soft yellow wildflowers in the other hand. Look gently toward the flower with a happy curious soft smile. Readable natural hands and physical flower stems, basket held convincingly. White cotton-tail may peek naturally if angle permits. Pastel green meadow and tiny flowers with soft distant foliage, morning sunlight, airy natural atmosphere. Character remains dominant, no busy scenery, no other characters. Physically based fur and cotton/linen weave, individually resolved fur, soft warm key and subtle cool fill, crisp natural detail, restrained highlights, no plastic toy look, no 2D outlines, no text/watermark, no collage. Preserve species rather than turning into human girl with rabbit ears.
